# Alter Ego

> AI creative companion for YouTubers and creators: discover topics, shape an Alter Ego voice, and publish channel-ready content.

## Product

Alter Ego (ai-alterego.com) helps creators find trending topics, build a personal content style (Alter Ego), manage My Channel, and generate publish kits. Primary markets: Traditional Chinese (zh-TW), English, Japanese.
